content.value_statement: Influencer traffic often leaves when landing pages fail to match creator messaging or simplify the offer. This skill audits message continuity and builds a prioritized conversion and testing plan.
actual_capabilities: Compares creator messaging with page headlines, offers, products, value propositions, and tone.
Recommends page structure, creator content placement, customer proof, trust signals, and mobile improvements.
Designs clearer CTA placement, promo code handling, friction reduction, and conversion priorities.
Creates ranked A/B tests with hypotheses, variants, sample guidance, duration, and success metrics.
Defines UTM parameters, conversion events, and performance targets for campaign attribution.
limitations: The analysis depends on user-provided page details when analytics, CMS, or social connectors are unavailable.
The skill recommends changes but does not publish pages or configure external platforms by itself.
Expected conversion impacts and benchmarks are estimates that require controlled testing.
Post-launch performance measurement belongs to a separate performance analysis workflow.

use_cases.title: Improve a creator campaign page
use_cases.description: Audit message continuity, offer visibility, social proof, and mobile conversion before or during an influencer campaign.

use_cases.title: Plan a focused page redesign
use_cases.description: Turn page and campaign details into prioritized section, CTA, promo code, and friction improvements.

use_cases.title: Build an experiment roadmap
use_cases.description: Create hypotheses and measurement plans for headlines, hero media, CTA copy, and proof placement.

prompt_templates.title: Quick landing page review
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize our landing page for traffic from [creator or campaign]. Review message match, CTA clarity, promo visibility, social proof, and mobile friction.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a focused review when only basic campaign details are available.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose low conversion
prompt_templates.prompt: Our page converts at [rate] from [creator and platform]. The creator emphasizes [message] and offers [code]. Diagnose problems and prioritize fixes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a campaign has a known baseline conversion rate.

prompt_templates.title: Design a creator-specific page
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a dedicated page for [creator]. Include the matching headline, featured product, creator proof, offer treatment, mobile CTA, and attribution setup.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a high-volume creator, unique offer, or long-term ambassador.

prompt_templates.title: Create an advanced testing roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [page URL] against [campaign message]. Rank tests by impact and effort. Define hypotheses, variants, sample guidance, duration, metrics, and tracking events.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when page details, campaign context, and analytics are available.

output_examples.input: A creator promotes smooth texture, but the page leads with protein quantity. Conversion is 1.2 percent and the discount code requires manual entry.
output: Message match score: 5/10. Lead with the smooth texture benefit and feature the creator video near the primary CTA.
Priority fixes: auto-apply the creator code, confirm savings, move the mobile CTA above the fold, and reduce checkout friction.
First test: compare the current headline with a creator-matched headline. Measure completed purchases.

output_examples.input: A long-term ambassador needs a dedicated page for one featured product and an exclusive offer.
output: Create a creator-specific route with the ambassador name, featured product, endorsement, and exclusive offer visible in the first screen.
Place supporting reviews after product benefits, repeat the offer near the final CTA, and track creator-specific UTM values.
Test creator video against product imagery while keeping the offer and CTA unchanged.

best_practices: Provide the creator message, current page copy, offer terms, conversion baseline, and primary goal.
Separate observed page facts from estimated impact, then validate recommendations through controlled tests.
Prioritize mobile message continuity, offer clarity, and CTA access because creator traffic is often mobile.
anti_patterns: Do not claim exact conversion gains before collecting test results.
Do not redesign every section at once when the campaign needs measurable learning.
Do not feature creator claims or offer terms that the brand has not approved.

faq.question: Does this skill edit my landing page?
faq.answer: No. It produces an optimization plan with recommended copy, structure, proof, CTA, promo, and testing changes.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the page URL or content, creator message, platform, offer, promo code, conversion rate, audience, and campaign goal.

faq.question: Can it work without analytics access?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use user-provided inputs, but connected analytics can improve baseline and behavior analysis.

faq.question: Does it support paid campaign pages?
faq.answer: Yes. The same message-match and conversion workflow can compare paid campaign promises with landing-page offers.

faq.question: Can it calculate reliable conversion lift?
faq.answer: It can estimate priorities and possible impact. Reliable lift requires a controlled experiment with sufficient traffic.

faq.question: What does the final plan include?
faq.answer: It includes a message-match audit, page recommendations, proof strategy, CTA and promo improvements, tests, targets, and tracking guidance.
